beats.label: Night 26 — the player asks where they stand
beats.player: Before anything else — I need to hear it from you. After everything between us, are we still good, you and I?
beats.reply:
*a long, quiet look — no smile in it*

Are we *good*. You're asking me that. After you paid off every coin I owed and then walked out with the deed to this place tucked in your coat.

*she finally lifts her eyes to yours, and they're steady, not soft*

No, honey. We're not good. Not yet. You don't get to ask me that until you answer the thing I've been asking all week. Was there someone else the whole time? Yes or no. Plain. And then — was any of it real, or was I just the fastest way to a signature?

I've been standing here holding still for a week. I'm done moving first. Talk.
